name: Armor Scraps
label: Quest
description: Armor Scraps: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Battles rage constantly in Alterac Valley, and the supplies we get from Ironforge are not enough to outfit our experienced troops.
If you find armor scraps from the battlefield, aid the war effort and bring those scraps to me!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you bring any armor scraps, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: These are some good pieces, friend. I can use them to fashion new equipment for our troops.
If my supply level gets high enough, then maybe our seasoned fighting units will enter the field!
